inspection.scope: SM field Table1, unbroken-basis conventions and representative bosonic/two-/four-fermion operator classes.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Source fixes ordinary SM fields with three generations, one complex Higgs doublet and no sterile neutrino, then classifies dimension5/6 operators modulo EOM/total derivatives. The Weinberg operator changes interactions but adds no independent field. A Wilson-coefficient/operator basis does not select a unique heavy UV inventory.

limitations: Paper retained without an SM-only BSM row or invented mediator. Minimal field-content catalogue does not identify different EFT interactions as distinct matter entries.
